newsitem.title: UK: Guinness off amid worry over spirits sales.
newsitem.headline: Guinness off amid worry over spirits sales.

text.p: Shares in drinks and brewing group Guinness Plc stood 6-1/2p lower at 448-1/2p by 1123 GMT as analysts and traders voiced worries on Thursday about the company's spirits sales and its hopes for price rises.
Guinness reported scotch whisky sales four percent behind last year at 10.2 million cases in the six months ended June 30, mainly due to de-stocking in Latin America.

"I suspect people might have hoped for a better view on volumes and likewise with the average two percent increase in prices across the year, again expectations might have been slightly higher than that," said Colin Humphreys, analyst at Panmure Gordon.
"But it's moving in the right direction and cash returns to shareholders are very good," added Humphreys.

"The company has committed itself to a substantial increase in spending on advertising and promotion in the second half but it is living in hope that sales will increase to offset that," said Charles Winston, analyst at BZW.
